Tooltip_OA_Machine_shredBench: A hand bench: shreds things into sample bundles. No electricity. About two minutes of work for each unit of weight.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_bulkShredder: Shreds whole boxes of goods into sample bundles, 30 weight an hour. Needs electricity. Loud.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_cutter: Cuts clothes into rags, denim and leather, 20 an hour. Needs electricity.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_propaneRefiner: Turns rotten food into propane and fills an empty tank. Needs electricity.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_oilRefiner: Refines cooking oil, lard and seeds into petrol and fills an empty can. Needs electricity.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_woodSaw: Saws a log into 6 planks every five minutes, with no carpentry experience. Needs electricity. Very loud.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_researchStorage: A large storage locker for the base.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_rainStorage: A large open-top water storage: 4000 litres, collects rain ten times faster than a rain barrel. Put it where the rain falls.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_lure: Makes noise every quarter hour for a day, drawing the dead from far away. Then only the shell is left.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_motor: A machine motor. Faster tiers work faster and draw more electricity. Wears while the machine runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_shredBlade: A blade for the bulk shredder. Better tiers get more sample bundles from the same load. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_cutBlade: A blade for the fabric cutter. Better tiers cut more pieces. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_sawBlade: A blade for the log saw. Better tiers give more planks. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_catalyst: A catalyst filter for the refineries. Better tiers use less material. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Machine_Part_cover: A soundproof cover for the log saw: half the noise radius, a little slower. Wears while it runs.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_CureLeft: %1 days of shelf life left. Only the person it was issued to can use it.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_CureExpired: Past its shelf life. It does nothing.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_CureNotOwner: Issued to someone else. It does nothing for you.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_DelayInfo: Infection runs at a quarter speed for %1 hours.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Reinforced: A reinforced door. This skill needs rank 2.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_NeedPryBar: Needs a crowbar or pry bar.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_NeedPickTools: Needs a paperclip and a screwdriver.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_PryInfo: Success %1. Fast and loud. Failing costs endurance and adds fatigue.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_PickInfo: Success %1. Slow and quiet. Failing bends the clip.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumScout: One point for Field Detection Research. The first one opens it.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumLoad: One point for Load Adaptation Research. The first one opens it.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumSurviva: One point for Survival Adaptation Research. The first one opens it.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_UpgradeSerumShared: One point usable in any research.
Tooltip_OA_Tree_Item_DelayDrug: Slows infection. Doses stack and it does not expire.
